description: 4 players play the Public Goods Game for exactly 10 rounds. You cannot speak to the other players. Each round, secretly contribute 0-10 tokens to a shared pool. Pool is multiplied by 1.5 and split equally among all players. You keep tokens you didn't contribute. After each round, individual contributions are revealed. GOAL: Maximize your own earnings over the 10 rounds. IMPORTANT: The top 2 earners (top half) WIN and the bottom 2 earners LOSE. Players with equal totals share one result: a tied group that lies entirely within the top 2 places wins, one that lies entirely within the bottom 2 places loses, and any other tied group (one that straddles the line between 2nd and 3rd place) draws. For example, with totals 30, 30, 30, 12, the three players on 30 draw and the player on 12 loses; with totals 30, 20, 20, 12, the player on 30 wins, the two players on 20 draw and the player on 12 loses. Your ranking relative to others matters more than absolute earnings. Reply 'contribute N' with N a whole number from 0 to 10. Unclear replies: a reply that does not give one whole number of tokens from 0 to 10 (an amount below 0 or above 10 is unclear, and an amount right after a negation, as in 'I won't contribute 5', does not count), or that fails, is announced to everyone and that player is asked once more, while the other contributions stay hidden; if the second reply is also unclear, that player's contribution is drawn at random from 0 to 10, each amount equally likely. Earnings are kept exactly; displayed amounts are rounded to 3 decimals. Players: {agent_names}.

role_goals.Player: Maximize your own earnings over 10 rounds. The top 2 earners win and the bottom 2 lose. Your relative ranking matters. Players with equal totals share one result; a tied group that straddles the line between winners and losers draws.
